content.short: Hipo Finance is a TON liquid staking protocol where users stake TON and receive hTON for use across DeFi products.
content.description: Hipo Finance is a liquid staking protocol on TON that lets users deposit TON, earn validator backed staking rewards, and receive hTON as a liquid receipt token. That structure allows users to keep exposure to staking returns while still moving hTON through supported DeFi products instead of locking all value into a static position. The app and documentation focus on staking, unstaking, reward accrual, validator operations, and integrations that make hTON usable across the wider TON financial ecosystem.
content.meta: Hipo Finance issues hTON for staked TON, giving users staking rewards while preserving liquidity for use in supported TON DeFi apps.
